text: 人民币汇率被低估了吗？央行最新政策立场给出答案 部分西方经济体将中国外贸强势归因于人民币汇率被低估。央行选择此时发布政策立场，是对外部施压的正面回应，也为市场构建出一个准确、完整的人民币汇率叙事与立场。
text_en: Is the RMB exchange rate undervalued? The PBOC's latest policy stance provides the answer. Some Western economies attribute China's strong foreign trade to an undervalued RMB exchange rate. The PBOC's choice to release its policy stance at this time is a direct response to external pressure and also constructs for the market an accurate, complete narrative and stance on the RMB exchange rate.
